statement: Between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-21 the United States and Iran both publicly announce a concluded agreement reopening the Strait of Hormuz to commercial transit.
resolution: TRUE if a US government body and an Iranian government body each publicly confirm a concluded Hormuz transit agreement dated between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-21, per two international wire services.
failure_condition: Both governments do not publicly confirm a concluded Hormuz transit agreement inside the stated window.

statement: Between 2026-08-05 and 2026-08-25 a single long-range strike incident in Ukraine kills ten or more people.
resolution: TRUE if Ukrainian state emergency or prosecution authorities report ten or more killed in one strike incident dated in the window, corroborated by two international wire services.
failure_condition: No single strike incident dated in the window reaches a confirmed toll of ten or more killed.

statement: Front-month ICE Brent crude settles at or below USD 70.00 per barrel on at least one trading session between 2026-08-05 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if the published ICE Brent front-month settlement price is 70.00 USD per barrel or lower on any trading session dated between 2026-08-05 and 2026-09-30.
failure_condition: Front-month Brent settles above 70.00 USD on every trading session in the window.

statement: The FOMC leaves the federal funds target range at 3.50 to 3.75 percent at its scheduled 2026-09-16 decision.
resolution: TRUE if the FOMC policy statement released 2026-09-16 states a target range of 3.50 to 3.75 percent, per the Federal Reserve statement and FRED series DFEDTARU and DFEDTARL.
failure_condition: The September FOMC statement sets any target range other than 3.50 to 3.75 percent.

statement: The S&P 500 closes down 3.00 percent or more from the prior close on at least one session between 2026-08-05 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if official S&P 500 closing values show a single-session close-to-close decline of 3.00 percent or greater on any date between 2026-08-05 and 2026-09-30.
failure_condition: No session in the window produces an S&P 500 close-to-close decline of 3.00 percent or more.

statement: The CISA KEV catalog adds a further N-able N-central vulnerability with a date-added value between 2026-08-05 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog contains an N-able N-central CVE other than CVE-2026-18577 and CVE-2026-18556 carrying a dateAdded value between 2026-08-05 and 2026-10-31.
failure_condition: No further N-able N-central CVE carries a KEV date-added value inside the window.

statement: The United States Senate confirms Todd Blanche as Attorney General in a recorded floor vote held between 2026-08-05 and 2026-10-16.
resolution: TRUE if a Congress.gov Senate roll call vote dated between 2026-08-05 and 2026-10-16 records confirmation of the Blanche nomination to be Attorney General.
failure_condition: No Senate roll call inside the window records Blanche confirmed as Attorney General.

statement: Federal defendants file a notice of appeal of the ruling blocking the New York ban on ICE officers wearing masks, docketed between 2026-08-05 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if the district court docket in that case shows a notice of appeal filed by federal defendants and dated between 2026-08-05 and 2026-09-30.
failure_condition: No notice of appeal by federal defendants is docketed in that case inside the window.

statement: The man charged over the largest 2026 Washington state wildfire faces at least one arson count filed and not dismissed at any point between 2026-08-05 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: TRUE if the Washington state court docket for that defendant shows an arson count filed and not dismissed on a date between 2026-08-05 and 2026-09-30.
failure_condition: The docket shows no arson count, or every arson count is dismissed before 2026-09-30.

statement: GDACS carries a tropical cyclone alert for Dolphin at orange or red level listing Japan among affected countries between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-14.
resolution: TRUE if the GDACS tropical cyclone event record for Dolphin shows an orange or red alert level with Japan listed as an affected country at any point in the window.
failure_condition: The GDACS Dolphin event never reaches orange or red alert with Japan listed as affected during the window.
